overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 57.15% annualised against 25.68% volatility (Sharpe 1.71) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. KHC carries the largest weight at 3.0%; MRNA dominates risk contribution at 10.7%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.96% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.63% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.40%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 7.01%, 99% VaR 17.76%, CVaR 95% 13.50%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.61%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-56.44% return, max drawdown -58.19%, worst day -13.62%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 19.59% vs realised 18.87% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: ARE, AIG, MRNA, MU, WDC, SNDK, LITE, STX, CVS, EQT have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 47 positions. The most concentrated trade is ARE at 0.0% of 30-day ADV. At a 20% participation rate, the slowest unwind would be ARE at 0.0 trading days — manageable but worth keeping in mind for any rapid de-risk. Current sizing tracks Kelly recommendations closely.
